<script lang="ts">
	import type { LabelProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: LabelProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Label for the control; wrapping a whole field turns it into a selectable card. -->
<label class={["fieldLabel", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</label>

<style>
	/* Base label */
	.fieldLabel {
		display: flex;
		align-items: center;
		gap: var(--spacing-sm);
		width: fit-content;
		font-weight: 500;
		line-height: 1.375;
		user-select: none;
	}

	/* A label that wraps a field is a bordered card that fills the row */
	.fieldLabel:has(> :global(.field)) {
		flex-direction: column;
		align-items: stretch;
		transition-duration: 150ms;
		transition-property: border-color, background-color;
		transition-timing-function: cubic-bezier(0.4, 0, 0.2, 1);
		border: 1px solid var(--border);
		border-radius: var(--radius-md);
		width: 100%;
	}

	.fieldLabel > :global(.field) {
		padding: var(--spacing-lg);
	}

	/* =============== States =============== */

	/* The card highlights while its checkbox, radio, or switch is checked */
	.fieldLabel:has(> :global(.field)):has(:global([aria-checked="true"])) {
		border-color: var(--primary);
		background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 5%, transparent);
	}

	:global(.dark) .fieldLabel:has(> :global(.field)):has(:global([aria-checked="true"])) {
		background-color: color-mix(in oklab, var(--primary) 10%, transparent);
	}

	/* Disabled state from the control inside */
	.fieldLabel:has(:global(:disabled)) {
		opacity: 50%;
		cursor: not-allowed;
	}
</style>

<script lang="ts">
	import type { LegendProps } from "./index.js";
	const { variant = "legend", children, class: className, ...props }: LegendProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Heading of the fieldset. -->
<legend class={["fieldLegend", className]} data-variant={variant} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</legend>

<style>
	/* Base legend; a legend ignores the fieldset gap, so it sets its own space below */
	.fieldLegend {
		padding: 0 0 var(--spacing-md);
		font-weight: 500;
	}

	/* =============== Variants =============== */

	.fieldLegend[data-variant="legend"] {
		font-size: var(--text-md);
		line-height: var(--line-height-md);
	}

	.fieldLegend[data-variant="label"] {
		font-size: var(--text-sm);
		line-height: var(--line-height-sm);
	}
</style>
{#if children} {@render children()} {/if}

<script lang="ts">
	import type { SetProps } from "./index.js";
	const { children, class: className, ...props }: SetProps = $props();
</script>

<!-- Related fields under one legend. -->
<fieldset class={["fieldSet not-typeset", className]} {...props}>
	{@render children()}
</fieldset>

<style>
	/* Base fieldset; resets the native border and padding */
	.fieldSet {
		display: flex;
		flex-direction: column;
		gap: var(--spacing-xl);
		margin: 0;
		border: 0;
		padding: 0;
		min-width: 0;
	}

	/* Checkbox and radio lists sit closer to their legend */
	.fieldSet:has(> :global(.radioGroup)),
	.fieldSet:has(> :global(.fieldGroup .checkbox)) {
		gap: var(--spacing-md);
	}
</style>
{@render children()}
